title: fal-ai/wan/v2.2-a14b/image-to-video/turbo input
description: Input schema for the Wan Turbo image-to-video model as used by the Content Factory adapter. Captured from https://fal.ai/models/fal-ai/wan/v2.2-a14b/image-to-video/turbo/api on 2026-10-21 without calling inference.

image_url.description: URL of the input image. The adapter sends a base64 data URI of a normalized JPEG/PNG at most 1280 px on the long edge and at most 3 MiB before base64.

prompt.description: Text prompt that guides video generation.

end_image_url.description: URL of an optional end image. The adapter does not use this field in the basic template.
